description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Our engineers are reshaping the payments landscape. We’re looking for more talented problem solvers to help us address a unique set of challenges.

As an engineer at Adyen, you will be responsible for the full development cycle from software design to testing and ensuring everything works as expected in production. You will work with one of the biggest PostgreSQL databases out there, focusing on maintaining the platform's performance and reliability.

We are looking for  Senior Java Engineers to join one of our teams within our payments solution. 

Payments solution:

As a Java Software Engineer within payments solution, you will build and improve integrations at a global scale for in-store and online payments. We make sure that our merchants and partners have a seamless integration with the Adyen platform. 

We are responsible for:

Building the best and most efficient payment engine globally

Building connections to all relevant payment methods and card schemes (Visa,Mastercard, Amex, etc) worldwide. Removing the complexity for our businesses to integrate them separately. Create a high-available, highly-scalable payment processing platform and connect to hundreds of external APIs. Given our global scale, automating all core processes to match funds to the penny, is a continuous challenge.

Deliver an industry leading user experience

Expand and modernize our portal for our external and internal users. Build a foundation where other solutions can build on top of. You will work on new features for our portal, improving the performance of existing frameworks or building automation APIs which enable platform growth in a scalable way. You will be focusing on providing APIs and UIs to our Merchants to enable self-service.

Who you are:

  • You have experience with Java, web services, REST APIs and SQL / PostgreSQL
  • You have worked with and deployed high-throughput and highly reliable services
  • You are proactive, you take ownership and you strive for quality, from both a technical and product perspective
  • You have excellent communication skills and you can explain complex, technical concepts to a non-technical audience
  • You are a team player who knows when and how to involve other people to hear different perspectives
  • You know how to evaluate tradeoffs and how to balance speed vs tech debt
  • You enjoy working on a global product that impacts millions of people everyday
  • Nice to have: experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Elasticsearch

What you’ll do:

  • You will build and maintain our distributed high-performance platform
  • You will be part of a diverse and inclusive team
  • We launch fast and iterate often. Concretely, this means that within your first few weeks, you will bring code live that impacts many businesses and shoppers
  • You will be fully responsible from its initial design to bringing new functionality live
  • Identify and improve parts of the platform to make it more robust and scalable
  • Collaborate across teams and time zones to make things happen, review code and be open to feedback

These roles are based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.
reasoning: This role is an excellent fit for Asjon. He is a senior Java engineer based in Utrecht, with Amsterdam as a commutable office location, and he is open to on-site/hybrid work. His 10 years of experience, including eight at Rabobank, cover Java, REST APIs, SQL/PostgreSQL, and full-cycle development in a fintech context, directly matching the core requirements. He has demonstrated product ownership, stakeholder communication, and CI/CD ownership, aligning with Adyen's expectation of engineers who take full responsibility from design to production. The primary gap is the scale of high-throughput distributed systems at Adyen, but his track record of building production systems and handling critical bugs suggests he can grow into this. His interest in fintech and technical ownership further strengthens the match.

This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

Software Engineer - Java Application Core Components (JACC)

Adyen provides a global, unified platform built by Java application teams across the company. The Java Application Core Components (JACC) team plays a key role in this: we build and maintain the shared frameworks and components that define how other Adyen teams design, structure, and deploy their Java applications.

As part of JACC, you will build and maintain the core Java tools and components used across all of Adyen, shaping how other engineering teams build their services. You'll work on some of the largest ongoing efforts in the company, including 3 large-scale migrations that will shape the future of Adyen's application architecture. You'll join a lean team of 6 Java experts, working in a Kanban-like way with minimal process overhead, and gain real influence over the architecture of one of the leading players in the payments space.

What you will do

  • Design, build, and evolve the internal and open source Java frameworks and components used by every Java application team at Adyen.
  • Play an active role in one or more of the team's 3 large-scale migrations that are reshaping Adyen's application architecture.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to other engineering teams, by guiding them on how the frameworks and libraries we provide can be used to solve Adyen's business problems.
  • Design and evolve workflows used by other engineering teams across Adyen, working closely with them to identify pain points and improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with partner platform teams (Kubernetes infrastructure, deployment, security) to make sure our components integrate well across Adyen's tech stack.
  • Advocate for best practices across Adyen and define boundaries/guidance on how the frameworks/libraries we maintain can be used. This should be achieved by creating code validation rules, running workshops and giving presentations to other development teams.

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience with Java backend development
  • Strong skills in core Java and code/API design
  • Track record of building high-quality software, with testing at all levels
  • A communicative, proactive team player

Nice to have

    • Experience with Kubernetes/cloud migrations, legacy application modernization, security-related work or platform development experience
    • Experience developing and maintaining libraries/frameworks used by many other developers (either open source or internal)
    • Experience with build tools, ideally for Java (Gradle/Maven)
    • Broader architecture sense across distributed systems
    • Familiarity with Spring, Jersey, Feign, OpenAPI
    • Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
    • Exposure to AI agent workflows and a DevOps mindset

 

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.
reasoning: Asjon is a senior Java engineer with a decade of backend experience, most of it in fintech at Rabobank, which aligns directly with Adyen's payments domain. His deep DevOps and CI/CD ownership, plus hands-on AI agent projects (REA Bot, JobHopper), match several nice-to-haves like a DevOps mindset and exposure to AI workflows. The role's office-first policy in Amsterdam works well since he lives in Utrecht. The main gap is lack of explicit experience building shared internal frameworks or libraries, but his track record of guiding teams, leading proof-of-concepts, and modernising a 9-year-old codebase shows the transferable skills. Overall, this is a close fit for a senior Java platform role.

About the opportunity

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to join the Data Storage Team within the Platform Engineering Domain. 

Platform Engineering's mission is to provide trusted, performant, and self-service platforms, enabling product teams to build 'the bank the world loves to use.' As part of this, this team is responsible for architecting and operating highly scalable, secure and compliant infrastructure solutions that manage our core database offering and data storage capabilities. The ideal candidate is a seasoned SRE,  an enthusiastic learner eager to pioneer novel platform solutions and grow with a team that values innovation and mentorship. If your expertise meets curiosity, we encourage you to apply.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and Implement: Build and maintain platform solutions that improve the reliability, security, and scalability of our Database Platform infrastructure.
  • Operational Excellence: Apply cloud infrastructure, networking, and CI/CD best practices to support our operational data storage solutions.

  • Knowledge Sharing: Participate in technical discussions and contribute to documentation, fostering a culture of transparency and continuous learning.

  • Observability: Maintain and enhance observability solutions (metrics, logging, tracing) to ensure the platform meets its SLOs and availability targets.

What you need to be successful

Background and Skills:

  • Hands-on experience in maintaining cloud-based infrastructure, particularly in AWS.
  • Practical experience with operational data storage solutions (e.g., PostgreSQL, AmazonRDS, S3 or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS)
  • Proficiency in infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • Competence in at least one programming language (Python preferred).

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn de practice JSRoots van Sopra Steria en wij bieden grote organisaties en semi-overheden op maat gemaakte, end-to-end softwareoplossingen. Hiermee helpen we klanten de juiste keuzes te maken en mooie resultaten te behalen. Hierin boeken we al jaren succes na succes! Wij geloven in de impact van teams bij onze klanten en het overgrote deel van onze diensten betreffen een multidisciplinair team van ontwikkelaars die een band opbouwen en samen de uitdagingen van de klant aangaan met training en ondersteuning vanuit Sopra Steria. We werken veel met de Nederlandse overheid, de vervoersector, banken en de Nederlandse Politie. Onze opdrachten variëren van grote webapplicaties tot korte pilotprojecten.

Als Senior Frontend developer bij JSRoots kan een opdracht het volgende inhouden: Een bestaande monolithische frontend-applicatie herschrijven naar een moderne microfrontend architectuur. Optimaliseren van de laadtijd en prestaties van een complexe Single Page Application (SPA). Implementeren van een Design System met componenten in React, Vue of Angular. Migreren van een legacy UI naar een moderne stack met bijvoorbeeld React en TypeScript. Het opzetten van een frontend CI/CD pipeline met tools zoals Vite, Webpack, Jest en Cypress. Integreren van een Progressive Web App (PWA) om offline functionaliteiten te ondersteunen. Adviseren over UX/UI-optimalisaties en toegankelijkheid (WCAG) binnen de organisatie. Werken met API’s en state management oplossingen zoals Redux, Vuex of Recoil. Krijg je ideeën hoe je dit verder kunt oppakken of jeuken je handen om hieraan te werken? Lees dan vooral verder! Wat zijn jouw kwalificaties? Als senior frontend developer verwachten we dat je: Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring hebt in frontend-ontwikkeling Ervaring hebt met moderne JavaScript-frameworks zoals React, Vue of Angular Ervaring hebt met TypeScript en component-based development Kennis hebt van CSS-in-JS, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS of andere moderne stylingoplossingen Ervaring hebt met testmethodieken (unit, integratie, end-to-end testing) en tools zoals Jest, Testing Library of Cypress Bekend bent met CI/CD-pipelines en DevOps-principes voor frontend-ontwikkeling Ervaring hebt met werken in een agile scrum omgeving Bijdraagt aan software-architectuur en technisch ontwerp Graag werkzaam bent in teamverband Een positieve mindset en oplossingsgerichte houding meebrengt In staat bent om kennis en ervaring met plezier over te dragen Een Bachelor in Informatica of een relevante gelijkwaardige opleiding hebt Ten minste Nederlands op B1/B2 niveau spreekt  Klinkt dit nog steeds bekend? Dan ben jij de developer die we zoeken, aarzel niet en solliciteer!

Dit krijg je van ons Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden: • Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.500,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). De exacte inschaling hangt af van jouw ervaring en de rol; • Vakantiegeld van 8%; • Een royaal mobiliteitsbudget in de vorm van een leaseregeling van €1.022- 1.209 met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto met NS Business Card of leasefiets of een alternatief vervoersregeling van €930 - 1.113,- net wat het beste bij jouw manier van reizen past; • Winstdeling van 8% on target (of OTB vast bedrag, afhankelijk van de functie); • 27 betaalde vakantiedagen; • Flex Benefits budget van € 1.800, - per jaar. Dit budget kan worden gebruikt voor zaken als aankoop van extra vrije dagen of extra sparen in jouw pensioenregeling; • Thuiskantoor met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding; • Hybride werken: thuis of op kantoor, afhankelijk van wat jij nodig hebt; • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en inspirerende (netwerk)events; • Sociale activiteiten met collega’s – van gezellige borrels tot sportieve of inhoudelijke uitjes; • Een flexibele pensioenregeling, waaraan jij op maat en passend bij jou, bijdragen kan toevoegen. • Je kunt deelnemen aan de collectieve zorgverzekering.   Lijkt deze job iets voor jou? Ben je klaar om met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Fantastisch! We kijken nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie! ______ Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
This is Adyen

At Adyen, we’re engineered for ambition. We empower our teams with the culture and support they need to own their careers. The people of Adyen are motivated problem-solvers who tackle unique technical challenges at scale, delivering innovative and ethical solutions to help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Adyen is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Amsterdam, someone with experience of building and operating robust machine learning systems at scale in production environments. You will be responsible for designing, productionizing and maintaining machine learning services that power data products at Adyen.

Teams Currently Hiring:

Identity and Verification Decisioning:

This is an opportunity to help define how Adyen makes identity decisions at global scale.

The team sits at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, fraud prevention, compliance, and customer experience. Rather than optimizing isolated models, you'll help build the intelligence that determines how millions of businesses and individuals are verified throughout their lifecycle.

You'll join a newly formed engineering team, giving you significant influence over the technical direction, architecture, and ML strategy from an early stage. Your work will directly impact fraud prevention, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and customer onboarding experience.

Optimise:

Optimize Intelligence at Adyen is a specialized team of Machine Learning Scientists and Data Analysts focused on maximizing transaction success, minimizing transaction costs, and driving payment performance at a global scale. We build and scale advanced ML/DL solutions that operate over massive, complex decision spaces, determining the optimal path for every single transaction in real time. Our systems evaluate high-dimensional data streams to dynamically select the optimal authentication methods, apply smart payment message optimizations, and orchestrate intelligent transaction routing. Our models live-score millions of daily transactions, balancing coupled cost and performance objectives simultaneously.

If you are passionate about solving intricate combinatorial challenges and pushing the boundaries of adaptive decision-making systems, join us in shaping the future of payments.

Account Risk Engine:

The Account Risk Engine is the team behind Adyen’s merchant fraud solutions. As Adyen expands its product lines, robust fraud prevention has become an essential offering, and we’re building a world-class, unified view of risk for our merchants. Machine Learning is what lets us scale it reliably. You’d join a multidisciplinary team where every engineer works with a high level of autonomy, leading projects while supporting colleagues on theirs, and we’re end-to-end responsible for what we build, from talking to stakeholders through to monitoring in production. Challenging the status quo is welcome, and decisions are shared, so everyone has a real voice in our biggest choices.

Payments Core Data - Disputes:

Adyen is building a dispute intelligence function. The team will be building ML and AI applications to make our dispute product more intelligent. We’re looking for someone with an optimization mindset, looking for an opportunity which allows for continuous experimentation and improvement by enriching the algorithms context (structured and unstructured data).

The challenge for the person refers to a greenfield opportunity, allowing for Disputes Machine Learning and AI use cases to be built from the ground up. You’ll be working side-by-side with both the Data Engineers and Machine Learning Scientists with respect to disputes data, and with the disputes engineering team who are owning the dispute product as a whole.

AML Tech:

Adyen's Anti-Money Laundering team processes massive transaction volume to detect complex financial crime and cover a wide range of customer risks. We currently run a hybrid stack of business rules and machine learning models - with a clear mission to systematically reduce our dependence on static rules and transition to a modern, model-first detection engine.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll play a critical role in this evolution. You will architect scalable batch processing pipelines, tackle hard technical challenges like extreme class imbalance and incomplete ground truth, and drive production ML systems that will make financial world safer for everyone.

In this role, you will: 

  • Develop and maintain production ML pipelines for data ingestion, training, validation, and deployment. Examples ML domains are: on-line learning algorithms to pick the best optimization decision in a changing environment, clustering algorithms to group customers/shoppers, supervised and semi-supervised learning methods for inference on risk patterns or graph analysis, representation learning for behavior prediction and monitoring, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) systems and real-time anomaly detection based on time-series modeling;
  • Identify and fix performance bottlenecks in ML training and inference (memory consumption, online latency, training time etc.);
  • Collaborate with software engineers to integrate ML solutions into products and services;
  • Collaborate with data scientists to transition research prototypes into scalable solutions;
  • Collaborate with MLOps and platform teams to integrate effectively with current tools, and shape priority for future tools;
  • Support and encourage good engineering practices on product ML teams;

Who You Are:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as an engineer working in the machine learning domain;
  • You are a strong Python programmer;
  • You have experience with the full machine learning model lifecycle in production flows;
  • You have experience leveraging big data to create the pipelines needed to feed the models with appropriate data;
  • You have a strong understanding of good software engineering practices as well as data engineering and MLOps principles;
  • You have knowledge of data science, statistics and machine learning techniques;
  • You have strong familiarity with the standard data science toolkit in python, such as (py)spark, (Trino) SQL, Tensorflow, PyTorch, XGBoost/LightGBM, Pandas, MLFlow or similar MLOps frameworks, and Airflow;
  • You have knowledge/experience of working with ML infrastructure components with tools such as k8s, docker, airflow, argo-workflows, prometheus, grafana
  • You have an experimental mindset with a launch fast and iterate mentality;
  • You proactively take the lead in projects, from ideation to deployment. You have experience working with a wide range of stakeholders and can clearly communicate complex outcomes over a wide range of audiences.

Nice to Have:

  • You have experience with distributed GPU compute environments
  • You have experience working with a Machine Learning ‘Feature Store’

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This is a full-time position based in our Amsterdam office, and it requires relocation if you are currently living outside of the Netherlands.

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. title: Test Automation Consultant

Je bent een teamplayer die samen met anderen gaat voor het beste resultaat en je kijkt verder dan alleen je eigen taken. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een vast contract en een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.000,- en € 5.800,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week); Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Vakantiegeld van 8%; Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten; Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie; 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen; Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten; Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding; Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events; Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen; Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld; Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen; Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren. Klaar om te groeien? Klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging bij een bedrijf dat net zo in beweging is als jij? Neem contact op met Valerie Palstra: valerie.palstra@soprasteria.com of solliciteer direct. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!  ______ Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. title: ML Engineer
description:
Als ML Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in de digitale transformatie van KPN. We zoeken iemand die zich moeiteloos beweegt tussen data science en engineering. Je werkt nauw samen met teams binnen en buiten het Data & AI-domein en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar schaalbare AI-oplossingen. Daarbij kun je rekenen op de expertise van je eigen team en andere AI-specialisten binnen KPN. Je vindt het leuk om zowel de data science- als engineeringkant van AI-producten op te pakken en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van bestaande oplossingen. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je werkt aan AI-oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt door miljoenen KPN-klanten en duizenden medewerkers. Je bent betrokken bij de volledige lifecycle: van experiment en modelontwikkeling tot implementatie en beheer in productie. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om actief bij te dragen aan de AI-transformatie van KPN en innovatieve technologieën om te zetten in concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair Data & AI-team met Data Scientists, ML Engineers en AI Translators. Samen ontwikkelen jullie innovatieve AI-oplossingen die direct bijdragen aan de strategische ambities van KPN. Als ML Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor: Het ontwikkelen van end-to-end AI-oplossingen, van idee tot productie. Het signaleren en realiseren van nieuwe mogelijkheden op het gebied van Machine Learning, AI en MLOps. Het ontwerpen en bouwen van machine learning modellen en algoritmes over meerdere complexe projecten Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe AI-capabilities voor de business en analytische teams. Het verbeteren van bestaande modellen en oplossingen. Het actief delen van kennis binnen en buiten het team. Het ondersteunen van collega's op het gebied van data science, engineering en tooling Het werken volgens DevOps-principes en eigenaarschap nemen over je oplossingen.

Je bent een nieuwsgierige en ambitieuze professional die impact wil maken met data en AI. Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar samenwerking, eigenaarschap en innovatie hand in hand gaan, en weet anderen mee te nemen in jouw ideeën. Met jouw conceptuele denkvermogen vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar slimme, praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen. Je hebt een natuurlijke drive om te verbeteren, daagt de status quo uit en ziet kansen waar anderen obstakels zien. Daarnaast ben je continu op zoek naar nieuwe kennis en technologieën, waardoor je jezelf én je team steeds verder helpt groeien. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee: Circa 5 jaar ervaring binnen data science, machine learning engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. Een afgeronde masteropleiding (of vergelijkbaar niveau) in bijvoorbeeld Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Wiskunde, Econometrie of Applied Physics. Een stevige basis in ML Engineering, van probleemdefinitie tot implementatie van oplossingen. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en beheren van machine learning-modellen. Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe Machine Learning Engineering projecten die verder gaan dan standaardoplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, Git, Docker en CI/CD-processen. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels; kennis van het Nederlands is een pré.

Natuurlijk hebben we als werkgever jou ook veel te bieden. Dit krijg je van ons:  Een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 5216,- en € 7843,- afhankelijk van je werkervaring, op basis van 40 uur exclusief 8% vakantiegeld  Vaste 13e maand, een deel krijg je maandelijks uitbetaald en een deel in januari van het volgende jaar. Óf je zet het in voor een FLEX & BOOST doel naar keuze! Klik hier om er meer over te lezen Jaarlijks een individuele en collectieve verhoging conform onze CAO € 1500 per jaar aan inzetbaarheidsbudget dat je naar eigen inzicht mag gebruiken voor bijvoorbeeld trainingen, coaching en cursussen Flexibele vrije dagen: onze collega’s mogen zelf (in samenspraak met de manager) bepalen hoe zij met verlof omgaan Een goede werk-privé balans (zoals 2 dagen kantoor, 3 dagen thuis, transitieverlof, feestdagwissel naar een feestdag van jouw religieuze of culturele voorkeur) Thuiswerkshop om je werkplek thuis optimaal in te kunnen richten, uiteraard met een mobiele telefoon & laptop 50% korting op onze producten en diensten, zodat je voordelig kunt internetten, bellen én streamen Goede reiskostenvergoeding: je krijgt je OV kosten volledig vergoed of € 0,23 per kilometer als je met de auto reist. Kom je liever op de fiets? Dan kun je aanspraak maken op onze fietsvergoeding € 0,40 per kilometer Mogelijkheid tot het aanschaffen van een leasefiets waar KPN maandelijks aan meebetaalt (bij onbepaalde tijd contract): Van stadsfiets tot e-bike en van racefiets tot speed-pedelec; jij kiest waar je op fietst Uitstekende pensioenvoorwaarden: een totale inleg van 25% van je pensioengevende salaris waarvan KPN 17,5% inlegt en jij 7,5% Ons geloof in technologie is groot. Dit wordt nóg krachtiger samen met menselijk contact, daarom ontmoeten we je graag!     Wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Martine Bunschoten via martine.bunschoten@kpn.com.       Bij KPN hebben we recruitmenttalent dat slim samenwerkt en zo wint. Daarom wordt acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature niet gewaardeerd.”

The candidate is a strong full-stack/backend engineer with 10+ years in Java, SQL, CI/CD and fintech, and has recent hands-on LLM API and agentic tooling experience in side projects, but that is hobby-level rather than the professional ML model development and MLOps depth this role demands. The candidate's education is a secondary school diploma, not the master's or equivalent the posting asks for, and there is no evidence of production ML model lifecycle ownership. Location (Amsterdam, NL) and seniority fit the candidate's preferences, and the DevOps/Python/CI-CD overlap is real, but the core ML engineering requirements are largely unmet, making this a tangential rather than realistic fit.

About the Role

At Together AI, you’ll build and operate one of the world’s largest GPU fleets used for frontier model training and inference. This isn’t a traditional infrastructure role—we’re looking for engineers who love building systems, automating everything, and solving problems at massive scale.

  • Continuously improve deployment velocity, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation.
  • Partner closely with hardware, networking, platform, and AI teams to push the limits of AI infrastructure.

  • 3+ years building distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or large-scale backend software.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, or Rust.
  • Experience building platforms, automation systems, or developer infrastructure.
  • Experience with Linux, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure technologies.

Bonus Experience

  • InfiniBand or RoCE networking
  • Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management
  • Large-scale AI training or inference clusters
  • Hardware health monitoring and predictive failure detection
  • Distributed storage systems
  • AI agents and autonomous infrastructure operations

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Application Policy 

Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. The Internationalisation team builds the platform that helps Stripe products work naturally across languages and markets. This role combines backend and platform engineering with emerging LLM technology.   • Experience building internal platforms that ultimately support customer-facing products.

title: Senior Android Engineer
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance  + benefits 
Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

 

About our Mobile Engineering discipline

Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds

There are ~60 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.

 Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

We’re searching for product-focused Android engineers to evolve our native mobile app. You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. 

You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 11 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.

As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.

You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both what we build, and how we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.

Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.

You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.

Our Android app

Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.

We use RxJava, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Dagger for dependency injection. We’re starting to use Coroutines for most new features. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data. We’ve built out our design system with Compose. 

We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.

We’ve previously written about building Monzo Chat on Android, which goes into detail on some of these elements.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You care about the impact your work has on our customers, and optimise for outcomes rather than the number of lines of code you output
  • You’re excited about and have experience in programming in Kotlin
  • You’ve shipped and iterated on at least one app in the Play Store
  • You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • You love turning excellent design into beautiful products
  • You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • You have an understanding computer science principles

🙌 What’s in it for you:

💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance  + benefits 

📍Barcelona, ESP

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of €1,200 a year for books, training courses and conferences

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Initial Call 
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise 
  3. Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview 

This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

There’s a detailed blog on the interview process, for extra details, hints and tips.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: Staff Security Engineer, Abuse Control
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) is Stripe’s rapid-response technical defense and control incubator. When urgent abuse vectors emerge, ACE uses real-world attacker telemetry to prototype, test, and deploy software safeguards before vulnerabilities can be exploited at scale.

We partner closely with Fraud, Risk, Abuse Research, and Product Engineering to run rigorous experiments that balance effective risk mitigation with legitimate user activity and conversion. Operating as both a strike team and an incubator, ACE builds automated regression suites to prevent threats from recurring and transfers mature controls to long-term product owners across Stripe.

What you’ll do

As an Abuse Control Engineer on the ACE team, you will design, prototype, and incubate technical defenses that safeguard Stripe’s financial ecosystem against complex, cross-cutting abuse vectors.

When emerging threat patterns reveal weaknesses in Stripe products, ACE rapidly builds and experiments with technical safeguards. Guided by empirical evidence and Stripe’s Fraud Taxonomy 3.0 (FT3) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into precise technical control requirements, such as API rate limits, step-up challenges, parameter validation, and pre-debit holds.

You will run experiments to evaluate risk reduction against the impact on legitimate user conversion, carefully balancing security and product velocity. You will manage controls through a structured incubation lifecycle, build automated regression suites to prevent threats from recurring, and partner with product engineering teams to transfer mature, long-term defenses.

Responsibilities

  • Rapid control prototyping: Design, prototype, and deploy technical controls across API, protocol, and product boundaries to address high-impact abuse vectors.
  • Evidence-based technical requirements: Translate empirical attacker evidence and FT3 threat research from Abuse Research, Fraud, and Security teams into precise technical abuse requirements and control specifications.
  • Control co-design: Collaborate with teams across Stripe to design resilient, secure controls across payments, onboarding, identity, and Connect surfaces.
  • Risk experimentation: Run rigorous experiments and A/B tests to measure risk reduction against the impact on legitimate user conversion, optimizing controls to minimize friction while neutralizing threats.
  • Regression testing: Build comprehensive regression test suites and automated attack simulations with Abuse Research to ensure mitigated abuse vectors do not recur.
  • Stakeholder management: Execute ACE’s incubation model by defining handoff criteria, operational documentation, timelines, and target dates for transferring successful controls to product teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, application security, or anti-abuse engineering in a high-scale production environment.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A strong software development background, with proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or a similar production programming language, as well as advanced SQL skills for analyzing system telemetry.
  • Experience using frontier AI models for software development, learning, and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience building API-level safeguards, rate-limiting frameworks, authentication or authorization checks, or input-validation controls.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks, including writing unit, integration, and regression tests for critical backend software.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across security, product, and platform teams to drive technical outcomes.

Preferred qualifications

  • A track record of designing and executing A/B tests, evaluating control efficacy, and balancing security safeguards against user conversion friction.
  • Expertise in threat modeling, secure systems architecture, and modern application-security design principles.
  • Familiarity with established threat frameworks, such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&CK, and experience applying adversary kill-chain analysis to build resilient defenses.
  • Knowledge of financial fraud vectors, threat-actor tactics, techniques, and procedures, and attacker infrastructure, including account takeover, card testing, and credential stuffing.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale data-processing platforms, such as Databricks, Trino, or PySpark, to monitor and measure control performance across distributed systems.
  • Experience incubating software features, establishing clear operational handoff criteria, and transitioning ownership to partner engineering teams.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering organization and play a key role in shaping the architecture, scalability, and long-term evolution of our platform.

As a Staff Engineer at Nozomi Networks, you will operate at both a technical leadership and hands-on engineering level, driving complex initiatives across teams while setting a high bar for engineering excellence. You will own critical areas of the system, influence architectural decisions, and mentor engineers, while delivering impactful features and platform improvements at scale.
The final job title (e.g., Software Engineer, Senior, or Staff) will be aligned to the successful candidate's demonstrated level of knowledge, skills, and impact, rather than years of experience.

You could be the next "Nozomier"! If this sounds like you, read on. 

In this role you will: 

  • Lead the design and evolution of distributed systems that power our OT/IoT cybersecurity platform
  • Drive architecture decisions with a long-term perspective on scalability, performance, and maintainability
  • Own cross-team initiatives, aligning engineering efforts with product and business priorities
  • Identify and systematically reduce technical debt, improving system reliability and developer productivity
  • Act as a technical multiplier, mentoring engineers and raising the bar on design, code quality, and operational excellence
  • Define and champion best practices in software design, testing, and observability
  • Collaborate closely with Product, SRE, and Security teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
  • Influence and improve engineering processes, ensuring effective delivery in a fast-paced agile environment
  • Take ownership of mission-critical features and services, from concept through production and beyond
  • Embody Nozomi Networks’ cultural pillars, promoting transparency, trust, and accountability

To be successful in this opportunity, you will have: 

  • Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems in production environments
  • Strong expertise in at least one core language: Golang, C++, or Ruby
  • Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript and React is a plus
  • Proven track record of technical leadership beyond team boundaries
  • Deep understanding of system design, algorithms, and data structures
  • Experience with modern backend architectures, APIs, and service-oriented systems
  • Solid background in automated testing strategies (TDD, BDD, integration testing)
  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and data modeling is a plus
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP , UDP , etc.) is highly valuable
  • Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to operate in high-trust, high-confidentiality environments

 

Who we are and what we stand for:

Nozomi Networks is the leader in OT and IoT Cybersecurity. We protect the world's critical infrastructure, industrial and government organizations from cyber threats by providing exceptional network visibility, threat detection and operational insight. We’re always innovating and we hire the best at what they do to ensure our customers always have access to fast product enhancements, exceptional engineering support and rapid deployment across continents. If you like a challenge, and value integrity and customer success, we invite you to help Nozomi Networks build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging are part of our core beliefs, at Nozomi Networks. Diversity of thought, background and culture broadens our knowledge of the world and helps us learn, grow, and gain new perspectives. What makes us all different is what makes us powerful.

Our Global Benefits

All of our benefits are customized to the country you are based in, naturally we want to get the best out of our Nozomiers, so we provide the best benefits packages, such as:

  • Health & Wellness
  • Financial
  • Work-Life Balance
  • Unparalleled Flexible Time-Off

Need to know information

Successful candidates will be subjected to background verification checks.

Be cautious of unsolicited messages, fake email addresses, requests for money and unclear job descriptions. Report suspicious activity to authorities. Our open job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Nozomi Networks' career page. If in any doubt please apply for opportunities on our careers website here.

If you would like to know more about our Privacy Policy, please click here. Any questions about how we process personal information, or if you would like help exercising your privacy rights please contact us using the email provided within the Privacy Policy.
reasoning: This is a Staff-level OT/IoT cybersecurity role requiring extensive distributed systems experience and strong expertise in Golang, C++, or Ruby. title: Supply Chain Data Engineer & Integration Manager
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Supply Chain Data Engineer & Integration Specialist, Amsterdam

Adyen is looking for a Supply Chain Data Engineer & Integration Specialist to join our team in Amsterdam. This high-impact role is positioned at the center of our operational systems landscape. You will own the technical architecture and data pipelines connecting our new Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) platform, Pigment, with our broader enterprise layers (Workday, Salesforce, Big Data Platform, Looker) and our global third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse networks.

This is an exceptional opportunity to build sustainable, long-term technical capability within our Supply Chain function. You will lead the technical integrations for upcoming warehouse expansions in key growth markets, directly enabling business expansion.

What you’ll do

  • Build & Maintain Data Pipelines: Architect, implement, and monitor robust, production-grade data pipelines that feed our planning platforms, ensuring that clean operational data reliably reaches Pigment in the exact shape required.
  • Industrialize POC Integrations: Take our initial automated prototype connections and harden them into scalable, secure, and production-ready enterprise integrations.
  • Integrate Key Enterprise Systems: Establish and maintain seamless system-to-system connections linking Pigment with Workday (Finance & Procurement), Salesforce (CRM), Big Data Platform, and reporting interfaces (Looker).
  • Connect Logistics Networks (3PLs): Build and maintain direct integrations with external warehouse management systems and global logistics partners (e.g., DHL APIs) to support real-time inventory tracking and automated stock reconciliation.
  • Drive Data Quality & MDM: Work closely with the Central Data Platform team to enforce Master Data Management (MDM) at the source systems before data flows into down-stream planning modules.
  • Support Global Expansion: Serve as the technical integration lead for our global warehouse expansions, ensuring robust local warehouse configurations from day one.

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience in data engineering, backend integration development, or a systems integration role.
  • You are highly motivated, proactive, and a natural problem solver with an eagerness to master supply chain, financial, and warehouse logistics systems.
  • You are highly proficient in database structures, SQL, and programming languages commonly used in data pipelines (e.g., Python, Apache Airflow, PySpark).
  • You have deep experience building API integrations (REST, SOAP), handling data transformation formats (JSON, XML, CSV), and managing enterprise connectors.
  • You bring an architectural mindset. You naturally engineer for pipeline resilience, including automated alerting, transaction retries, error-logging, and comprehensive unit/UAT testing.
  • You have a Data Governance and Architectural Mindset. 
  • You are a self-starter who actively seeks out inefficiencies, takes technical ownership of solutions, and delivers results without requiring constant hand-holding.
  • You can explain complex data architectures and pipeline failures clearly to operational planners and business stakeholders.
  • You are familiar with numerous AI models and embed AI usage in your daily work. 

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

We are looking for a Senior Identity Platform Engineer with focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) to join the Corporate Engineering team. As an SRE together with other engineers you will be responsible for the continuous operation, further development and enhancement of Planet’s corporate infrastructure and applications, acting as the technical authority for our enterprise identity ecosystem. 

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).
  • Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).
  • Scripting & Tooling: Use Python or Go to automate repetitive tasks, build custom provisioning connectors for legacy applications, and enforce identity data minimization.
  • Identify and reduce operational toil through automation, making our systems self-healing and predictable.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Leverage APIs, Terraform, Ansible, or SaltStack to manage configurations as code, moving away from manual UI/CLI changes across our identity platforms.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and drive the continuous improvement of incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes for complex authentication failures.
  • Collaborate closely with Security and other IT teams to embed reliability, scalability, and security best practices from the ground up, ensuring our identity architecture complies with GDPR and Zero Trust principles.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years experience in infrastructure development and/or operations, with a dedicated focus on Identity and Access Management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Expertise with a scripting language like Python.
  • Track record of working with large web applications or computer clusters and managing complex identity architectures (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).
  • Experience integrating HR Information Systems with identity directories and handling complex edge cases (re-hires, cross-border transfers).
  • Solid understanding of Network principles and operations alongside modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).
  • Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.
  • Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production environment.
  • Awareness of best practices about systems security and defensive programming
  • Experience with version control e.g. Git.
  • Experience in deploying and maintaining virtual machines e.g. KVM, ProxMox.
  • Experience in software development using CI/CD processes and tools e.g. Jenkins, GitLab.
  • Experience with Access Control systems, e. g. Avigilon, Verkada or dormakaba.
  • Experience with  Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and deployment automation, renewal, and revocation of personal S/MIME certificates.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - SAP Connectors
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

Fivetran's SAP connectors move enterprise data out of SAP and into modern data platforms. We're looking for an all-round SAP specialist who combines strong ABAP skills with deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing. You'll work on the interfaces and data extraction mechanisms that let Fivetran reliably pull data from SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems, and you'll help customers and internal teams get the most out of them.

You will be the SAP specialist within a team of Java developers. Your knowledge and input is crucial to the success of this team. 

 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • ABAP programming using traditional SAPGUI as well as Eclipse (or other IDE).
  • Databases (HANA/Oracle/etc)
  • Cloud environments (AWS/GCP/MS)
  • AI tools Claude/Codex/

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance ABAP components (function modules, classes, CDS views, and enhancements) to drive scalable outbound data extraction from SAP systems.
  • Own and modernize internal SAP test environments to accelerate feature development for current connectors and upcoming public cloud / BTP integrations.
  • Architect robust outbound interfaces leveraging OData, standard and generic DataSources, ODP/ODQ delta frameworks, and RFC connections.
  • Optimize data throughput and reliability across ECC and S/4HANA landscapes by diagnosing and resolving extraction performance bottlenecks and delta synchronization issues.
  • Analyze underlying SAP database structures (HANA and traditional DBs) to unlock efficiency gains and streamline data pipeline performance.
  • Partner closely with engineering, support, and customers to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical architectures.
  • Deliver end-to-end support for enterprise clients by troubleshooting complex connectivity, authorization, and configuration challenges in customer SAP environments.
  • Establish technical design standards, interface specifications, and best practice documentation for internal and external knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging SAP technologies—including SAP Datasphere and BTP—to keep Fivetran’s connectors at the forefront of modern data integration.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with strong ABAP skills (classic and modern ABAP, ABAP OO, ABAP for HANA)
  • Deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing:
    • OData (v2 and v4): service design, SEGW, performance, and security
    • SAP extractors: standard and generic DataSources, delta handling, ODP/ODQ, CDS-based extraction
    • RFC: function modules, BAPIs, destinations, and tRFC/qRFC
  • Solid working knowledge of both SAP ECC and S/4HANA, including the differences in data models and extraction options between them
  • Good knowledge of databases: SQL, query performance and tuning, SAP HANA, and relational database concepts
  • Understanding of SAP data models and key modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD)
  • Experience with SAP authorizations and technical user/role setup for interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent in English
  • Experience in code reviews, design, troubleshooting and testing
  • Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including connecting SAP to cloud data platforms
  • Java development experience
  • Familiarity with data integration/ELT tools and data warehousing concepts
  • Knowledge of SLT, SAP Datasphere, BW and SAP BTP.

title: Principal Software Engineer (Networking) - Platform Infra
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role
 
We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join Platform Infrastructure - Application Networking and set where Elastic Cloud application networking goes next. This work covers Ingress, security controls, private connectivity, and DNS management — the path every interaction with Elasticsearch, Kibana, and the broader Elastic stack takes. You will drive the technical vision, architecture, and design of these systems, not just execute against an existing roadmap.
This is a Principal-level role for an engineer who has designed high-performance, scalable networking platforms and can drive technical initiatives across organizations. Elastic is investing in the reliability, security, and reach of Elastic Cloud; you will hold a high bar for those qualities while other engineering teams rely on what this platform provides.
 
What You Will Be Doing
  • Set the technical direction for major application networking initiatives, owning designs from proposal through general availability.
  • Lead the development of Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls on a large scale for Elastic Cloud. Continuously identify and address issues related to performance, reliability, and operability.
  • Lead multi-quarter, cross-organizational projects that other Elastic engineering teams rely on, and guide these projects through to delivery.
  • Raise the operational quality of our services. Take charge of operational investigations from beginning to end. Lead complex incident investigations and reviews. Participate in on-call rotation.
  • Mentor and support engineers across the team, serve as a subject matter expert and trusted technical advisor to the wider engineering organization, and set the standard for how we build software.
  • Partner with and advise product management and senior engineering stakeholders on technical trade-offs, feasibility, and roadmap direction.
  • Identify and champion improvements to security, stability, and cost efficiency before they become problems. Untangle complexity and bring architectural clarity across the platform.
What You Bring
  • Experience with building software, including setting technical direction for complex distributed systems running production at scale (Staff or Principal level, or equivalent scope).
  • Deep expertise in application networking and cloud-native architecture. You should understand how services communicate at scale. Knowledge of how to design, operate, and evolve Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls is required.
  • You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components. You have experience guiding work involving multiple engineers.
  • You have operated high-availability SaaS platforms, responded to incidents, and improved reliability over time. You care about the quality of work shipped — testing, observability, and operability.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication. You communicate clearly and can influence direction across teams and levels without formal authority.
Bonus Points
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes networking (Cilium, external-dns, Envoy Gateway, and Crossplane) and with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its networking ecosystem.
  • You have contributed to CNCF or other open-source networking projects

title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.

The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.

What You'll Do

Detection engineering

  • Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.
  • Track detection quality as measured quantities: coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.

Response & automation

  • Own EMEA-hours incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.
  • Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.

Telemetry & partnership

  • Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship, working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
  • Threat hunt proactively across the estate, converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
  • Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
  • Practical incident response experience: you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

Nice to Have

  • Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.
  • Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship.
