Senior Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains

About Flexport

Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.

Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.

Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.

Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com.

The team: Autonomous Supply Chains

Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.

Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.

Stack: TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.

The role

As a Staff Applied AI Engineer on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll set the direction for the agents that run real logistics work. You'll find the highest-leverage problems in our operations, decide what's worth building, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. Nobody hands you a spec, and nobody needs to.

What you'll do

  • Set the technical direction for Forge: how its agents plan, remember, use tools and hand off to people.
  • Design and ship end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work, such as customs compliance, document processing, invoice validation and exception management.
  • Build the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows that make an agent trustworthy enough to run 24/7.
  • Stay on top of what's happening in the world of AI, and channel those innovations straight into the product. When Jev came out this fall, we had three use cases live within two weeks.
  • Work directly with operators, domain experts and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products, and measure whether they worked.
  • Cross organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders and get things done without waiting for permission.
  • Raise the bar for the team through design reviews, mentoring and the patterns other engineers build on.

You should have

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, and you've built seriously with LLMs, whether in production, in side projects or just because you couldn't stop yourself.
  • LLM fluency: agent patterns, tool use, RAG, prompt design and evaluation. You know the difference between what works in production and what looks good in a demo.
  • Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js. You can own a feature end to end.
  • Product instinct: you can tell what's worth building, not just how to build it.
  • A track record of leading ambiguous, cross-team technical work from idea to production.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English, including design docs that people actually read.

Nice to have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, such as Temporal.
  • Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications.

How we work

  • We value builders. People who think end to end, do their own discovery and ship independently. Nobody hands you a spec.
  • Your users sit next to you. Operators, customs experts and account teams work in the same office. Watch them use your tool, and fix it before dessert.
  • Any model, any harness. Use any frontier model from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, in all the popular coding harnesses. Our engineers manage swarms of coding agents from their first week.
  • We ship dozens of times a day, with continuous deployment and a platform team obsessed with making it safe and fast.
  • Hybrid, in English. We're together in our office on Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal, a few minutes from Dam Square, three days a week*. The other days are flexible. English is our working language, and we work daily with colleagues in the US and China.
  • No logistics background needed. Almost nobody joins knowing what an HTS code or a bill of lading is. The experts sit a few desks away.
  • Agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • Your work is visible: a small, senior team that reports to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas set the direction.
  • Real stakes: your agents act on real shipments for 13,000+ brands in 135 countries, so the impact is immediate and measurable.
  • You're early: the playbook for applied AI in logistics hasn't been written yet. You'll help write it.

What's in it for you

  • Equity for everyone: every team member becomes a shareholder in a pre-IPO company in a multi-trillion dollar industry.
  • 25 vacation days, based on full-time employment, plus Dutch public holidays.
  • Health insurance, fully paid: a collective plan with basic and additional packages. Flexport pays the monthly premium.
  • Pension: a defined contribution scheme.
  • Breakfast and lunch: daily catered lunch with vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and drinks in the office.
  • Commute covered: Flexport covers home-to-office commuting costs if you live outside Amsterdam.
  • Parental leave: time off for both parents to bond with a new child.
  • Wellbeing support: an Employee Assistance Program through Aetna for you and your household, at no cost.
  • Visa sponsorship: we sponsor visas for the right candidates and help you move to Amsterdam. Eligible international hires may also benefit from the Dutch expat tax ruling.

Our hiring process

  1. Application review: our team reviews your application.
  2. Recruiter screen: talk about your experience, the role and your questions about Flexport.
  3. Hiring manager screen: an initial conversation with the hiring manager.
  4. Remote live coding: a live coding interview over video.
  5. Onsite coding and system design: coding and system design interviews in our office.
  6. Project deep dive: discuss a project from your experience with the hiring manager.
  7. Team debrief: the interview team reviews feedback together. You don't attend this step.
  8. Offer: if there's a match, your recruiter walks you through the offer.

 

Your recruiter will confirm the plan before interviews begin. We only contact candidates from @flexport.com addresses, and we will never ask you for money or banking details.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Climate Matters More Than Ever

Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.

Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.

The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.

The Opportunity

Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.

You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.

Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.

Things We ❤️

  • Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.
  • Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.
  • Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.
  • Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.
  • Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.

You Will

  • Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.
  • Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.
  • Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.
  • Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.
  • Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.
  • Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.
  • Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.
  • Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.
  • Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.

You Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.
  • A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.
  • Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.
  • Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.
  • The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.
  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.
  • A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.
  • An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.

Nice to Have

  • A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.
  • Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.
  • Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.
  • Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.

Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.

How We Work

  • Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.
  • You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.
  • We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.
  • In Amsterdam, we come to the office two to three times a week to collaborate, whiteboard, and spend time together.
  • Flexport’s broader technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake. We welcome candidates from different technology backgrounds.

What’s in It for You?

  • Direct ownership of products that help customers make better supply chain and environmental decisions.
  • The opportunity to shape Climate technology with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Flexport.
  • Equity participation and a defined pension contribution scheme.
  • 25 vacation days based on full-time employment.
  • Fully paid premiums for Flexport’s collective health insurance plan.
  • Catered lunches, breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office.
  • Covered home-to-office commuting costs for employees living outside Amsterdam.
  • Employee assistance and parental leave benefits.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Senior Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains

About Flexport

Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.

Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.

Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.

Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com.

The team: Autonomous Supply Chains

Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.

Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.

Stack: TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.

The role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. You'll find the most painful problems in our operations, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work, such as customs compliance, document processing, invoice validation and exception management.
  • Build the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows that make an agent trustworthy enough to run 24/7.
  • Stay on top of what's happening in the world of AI, and channel those innovations straight into the product. When Jev came out this fall, we had three use cases live within two weeks.
  • Work directly with operators, domain experts and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products, and measure whether they worked.
  • Move fast from idea to production, and treat every deployment as a chance to learn.
  • Cross organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply and get things done without waiting for permission.

You should have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, and you've built seriously with LLMs, whether in production, in side projects or just because you couldn't stop yourself.
  • LLM fluency: agent patterns, tool use, RAG, prompt design and evaluation. You know the difference between what works in production and what looks good in a demo.
  • Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js. You can own a feature end to end.
  • Product instinct: you can tell what's worth building, not just how to build it.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English, including design docs that people actually read.

Nice to have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, such as Temporal.
  • Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications.

How we work

  • We value builders. People who think end to end, do their own discovery and ship independently. Nobody hands you a spec.
  • Your users sit next to you. Operators, customs experts and account teams work in the same office. Watch them use your tool, and fix it before dessert.
  • Any model, any harness. Use any frontier model from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, in all the popular coding harnesses. Our engineers manage swarms of coding agents from their first week.
  • We ship dozens of times a day, with continuous deployment and a platform team obsessed with making it safe and fast.
  • Hybrid, in English. We're together in our office on Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal, a few minutes from Dam Square, three days a week*. The other days are flexible. English is our working language, and we work daily with colleagues in the US and China.
  • No logistics background needed. Almost nobody joins knowing what an HTS code or a bill of lading is. The experts sit a few desks away.
  • Agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • Your work is visible: a small, senior team that reports to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction.
  • Real stakes: your agents act on real shipments for 13,000+ brands in 135 countries, so the impact is immediate and measurable.
  • You're early: the playbook for applied AI in logistics hasn't been written yet. You'll help write it.

What's in it for you

  • Equity for everyone: every team member becomes a shareholder in a pre-IPO company in a multi-trillion dollar industry.
  • 25 vacation days, based on full-time employment, plus Dutch public holidays.
  • Health insurance, fully paid: a collective plan with basic and additional packages. Flexport pays the monthly premium.
  • Pension: a defined contribution scheme.
  • Breakfast and lunch: daily catered lunch with vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and drinks in the office.
  • Commute covered: Flexport covers home-to-office commuting costs if you live outside Amsterdam.
  • Parental leave: time off for both parents to bond with a new child.
  • Wellbeing support: an Employee Assistance Program through Aetna for you and your household, at no cost.
  • Visa sponsorship: we sponsor visas for the right candidates and help you move to Amsterdam. Eligible international hires may also benefit from the Dutch expat tax ruling.

Our hiring process

  1. Application review: our team reviews your application.
  2. Recruiter screen: talk about your experience, the role and your questions about Flexport.
  3. Remote coding: your first coding interview takes place over video.
  4. Onsite coding and system design: a second coding interview and system design in our office.
  5. Project deep dive: discuss a project from your experience with the hiring manager.
  6. Team debrief: the interview team reviews feedback together. You don't attend this step.
  7. Offer: if there's a match, your recruiter walks you through the offer.

An additional remote coding round may be needed if the earlier coding interviews leave questions to resolve. Your recruiter will confirm the plan before interviews begin. We only contact candidates from @flexport.com addresses, and we will never ask you for money or banking details.

Our unparalleled solutions empower you to orchestrate, manage and monitor your workflows across any application, service or server — in the cloud or on premises — with confidence and control, leveraging AI throughout the development process.

Redwood’s global team of automation experts and customer success engineers provide solutions and world-class support designed to give you the freedom and time to imagine and define your future. CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Java / SAP Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team. In an environment where our SDLC is powered by cutting-edge AI tools (including generative AI for coding, testing, and documentation), your primary focus will shift from boilerplate implementation to high-level system architecture, critical evaluation of AI-generated code, and complex problem-solving across both Java cloud platforms and SAP ERP environments.

This role is for a developer who sees AI not as a replacement for skill, but as a force multiplier that demands greater judgment, technical depth, and prompt engineering expertise. Leveraging AI, you will work across the entire software development Lifecycle to enable connectivity into SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems—collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality, impactful solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Enhanced Development & SAP Connectivity: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable Java microservices (primarily using Spring Boot/Spring Framework). Utilize AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, internal tools) to increase speed and offload repetitive tasks.
  • Critical AI Code Review & Optimization: Serve as the final technical authority on all AI-generated code. Rigorously review, debug, and optimize suggested code for performance, security, and adherence to SAP Clean Core standards and enterprise design patterns.
  • System Architecture & Hybrid SAP Connectivity: Lead the design and implementation of distributed connectivity components across hybrid SAP ECC and S/4HANA estates, ensuring resilience, low latency, and clean data structures.
  • Prompt Engineering for SDLC: Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques to maximize the efficacy of generative AI tools for writing comprehensive unit/integration tests, drafting technical documentation (Javadoc, API specs), and generating code refactoring suggestions.
  • CI/CD and Observability: Oversee and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (CI/CD, Kubernetes/Docker) in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure/GCP), leveraging AI tools for proactive anomaly detection and monitoring.

Required Technical Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in developing enterprise-level applications using Java (8+ / modern Java).
  • Proficiency with the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security).
  • Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD), software design patterns, and Microservices architecture.
  • SAP Connectivity & Clean Core Architecture: Proven experience building with SAP Clean Core principles across both SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments.
  • SAP Basis & Technical Integration Literacy: Familiarity with SAP Basis administration concepts, system architecture, RFC connections, secure gateways, and system integration troubleshooting.
  • Strong practical experience with concurrency and multithreading in Java to build highly performant services.
  • Proficiency in modern DevOps practices, including Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Solid understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., ReactJS, MobX).
  • Experience with relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis).

Essential AI-Era Skills (The "New Bar")

  • AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated ability to proficiently use AI-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer) in a production environment.
  • Code Judgment: Proven track record of evaluating and overriding AI-generated suggestions that are technically correct but architecturally flawed or non-compliant with security and performance best practices.
  • Prompting Proficiency: Experience writing clear, contextual, and effective prompts for generative AI to produce usable code, tests, or documentation.
  • Adaptability & Learning: High degree of curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new AI tools and techniques that continuously reshape the development workflow.
  • Domain & Architectural Focus: The capacity to abstract away from low-level coding details to focus on high-value business logic and systemic architectural integrity.
  • Cloud-First Mentality (AWS): A strong bias towards cloud-first development, with specific expertise in architecture and deployment on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience with message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Understanding of agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) or behavior-driven development (BDD).
  • Experience in the automation or SaaS industry.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong GitHub portfolio.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive compensation package, comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Opportunity to work on innovative and impactful products that are transforming industries.

  • Work with a highly skilled, passionate, and diverse  team of engineers.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • “One Redwood” company culture.

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: AI Engineer - Network
description:
As an AI Engineer, you will design, build and maintain agentic AI solutions that power KPN’s move towards autonomous networks—creating intelligent agents that can observe, decide, and act to optimize performance in real time. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders (across TDO and CM), domain experts, and engineering teams to develop scalable AI solutions and platforms to bring autonomous capabilities reliably into our operational processes. Key daily responsibilities: Build, develop, and maintain agentic AI systems that enable autonomous network optimization and decision-making (e.g. the disruption broadband agent). Make system designs, validate software quality, check run-time behavior and focus on production ownership. Build and maintain scalable AI/ML pipelines with a strong focus on reliability, performance and maintainability. Define and implement monitoring, testing, and governance strategies to ensure robustness and compliance of agentic AI solutions in production. Collaborate with network domain experts, data engineers, and software teams to integrate agentic solutions into real-time network environments. Translate network objectives into data-driven, self-adapting models using reinforcement learning and emerging AI tools. Stay up to date on innovations in agentic AI, reinforcement learning, and telecom network automation.

You are eager to learn and can adapt quickly, both technically and personally. You have strong analytical skills and take ownership of your work. You enjoy working with both technical and non-technical colleagues and can make complex ideas easy to understand. To be successful in this role, you bring: A strong background in software engineering (e.g. designing, building, and operating distributed systems in production). Solid experience with Python and/or Java, including writing clean, testable, and maintainable code. Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques in production, not just experimentation (e.g. model deployment, monitoring, lifecycle management). Experience with AI/ML frameworks and the ability to integrate models into larger software systems. Understanding of end-to-end AI systems, including data pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and feedback loops. Familiarity with cloud-native architectures (e.g. containerization, CI/CD, scalable services) and building reliable platforms. Interest in reinforcement-learning and agentic AI, actively exploring emerging frameworks and research to advance to autonomous solutions.  Work Location Schedule: Monday : Amsterdam Tuesday : Amersfoort (mandatory) Wednesday : Amsterdam (mandatory) Thursday : Amsterdam Friday : Client office

title: Databricks Data Engineer - Cross skilling program

You understand the responsibility that comes with building and running production systems, and you enjoy turning complex technical challenges into robust, reliable solutions. You have experience in software engineering, data engineering, or a related technical field, and you’re ready to take the next step in your career by deepening your expertise in data engineering and Databricks. You care about how systems work, not just getting them live. You want to build solutions that stand the test of time, continuously improve them, and make a meaningful impact for our clients. How you will help to create value at Xebia Databricks Division (XDD) XDD is one of Xebia's divisions, renowned for its expertise in building strong Data and AI solutions on Databricks that deliver value to our clients. In the past, our team has predicted daily bread demand for millions of loaves, built advanced energy-saving algorithms at a national scale, and built data platforms supporting millions of customers. You'll work with the sharpest data professionals in Europe, people who are not only technically brilliant but also generous with their knowledge. We enjoy the benefits of being part of a large organization while maintaining the energetic atmosphere of a scale-up. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om actief bij te dragen aan de AI-transformatie van KPN en innovatieve technologieën om te zetten in concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair Data & AI-team met Data Scientists, ML Engineers en AI Translators. Samen ontwikkelen jullie innovatieve AI-oplossingen die direct bijdragen aan de strategische ambities van KPN. Als ML Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor: Het ontwikkelen van end-to-end AI-oplossingen, van idee tot productie. Het signaleren en realiseren van nieuwe mogelijkheden op het gebied van Machine Learning, AI en MLOps. Het ontwerpen en bouwen van machine learning modellen en algoritmes over meerdere complexe projecten Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe AI-capabilities voor de business en analytische teams. Het verbeteren van bestaande modellen en oplossingen. Het actief delen van kennis binnen en buiten het team. Het ondersteunen van collega's op het gebied van data science, engineering en tooling Het werken volgens DevOps-principes en eigenaarschap nemen over je oplossingen.

Je bent een nieuwsgierige en ambitieuze professional die impact wil maken met data en AI. Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar samenwerking, eigenaarschap en innovatie hand in hand gaan, en weet anderen mee te nemen in jouw ideeën. Met jouw conceptuele denkvermogen vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar slimme, praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Connectivity
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the Platform Engineering Segment in the Mesh Team.

The mission of Platform Engineering is to provide trusted, performant, self-service platforms to empower product teams to build the bank the world loves to use.

As one of the first banks completely hosted in the cloud - our security, resilience and productivity standards require not only the use of a modern technology stack, but the building of teams in line with our principles and in the service of our product teams, the company and our customers.

In this role, you will:

Be responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining our service mesh in order to ensure the reliability, performance, and security of our services. Working in this area involves a deep understanding of microservices, service mesh architecture, networking protocols and cloud computing, as well as the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design, develop and implement systems, services and solutions, with the aim of improving the security, reliability, scalability and availability of systems in the following domains:
    • Service Mesh
    • Internal Networking
    • Partner Connectivity
    • Secrets Management
    • Service Discovery
  • Take ownership of our service mesh and it's underlying network stack and ensure its optimal performance and reliability
  • Ensure N26 availability by creating monitors and alerts, diagnose, and resolve issues related to the service mesh
  • Collaborate with other teams and support them in bringing critical new features to N26
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and new technology developments in service mesh
  • Identify and automate repetitive tasks
  • Monitor the health of your system and support them as part of an on-call rotation

What you need to be successful:

Background and skills:

  • Professional experience as an SRE or DevOps engineer
  • Hands-on, production experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • Knowledge of Go and/or Python
  • Broad understanding of systems (Linux) and networking (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, etc.)
  • Knowledge of VPNs and/or hands-on experience with implementation a bonus
  • Expertise in container virtualization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) as well as experience with service mesh implementations (Istio)
  • Performance monitoring and incident analysis
  • Knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Terraform, Vault, Consul, Salt/Ansible
  • Proactive, with an ability to work with a high degree of autonomy
  • Desire to learn, improve and leave systems in a better state than you found them in

Traits:

  • Independently lead tech projects
  • Lead and promote technical discussions with engineering audiences

title: VP, Software Engineering (NwPS)
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

VP, Engineering - Network Powered Solutions (NwPS) 

Why this role matters 

This is the engineering leadership role that shapes what Network Powered Solutions becomes - not just what it delivers. As the engineering function grows the person in this seat will define the architecture, build the platform, and drive the innovation strategy that turns network data into intelligent, production-ready capabilities.  

Working closely with Product, Commercial, and the GM, this leader will translate thought leadership into real engineering outcomes - including how NwPS solutions for agentic AI, digital identity, and emerging network API categories become a reality. This is not a delivery management role. It is a strategic engineering leadership position with full accountability for engineering vision, execution, and growth. 

Your key responsibilities 

Engineering vision & strategic leadership 

  • Define the engineering vision and long-term technical roadmap for NwPS, aligning investment and priorities with product strategy and commercial OKRs - shaping direction, not just delivering against it
  • Represent engineering on the SA NwPS leadership team alongside Product, Solution Sales, and Strategic BD - bringing a technical perspective to portfolio priorities and growth decisions
  • Partner with the CTO, Architecture, and SA CPaaS Engineering to shape shared platform standards and practices 

Architecture & technical strategy 

  • Define the architectural direction for NwPS engineering, with end-to-end accountability and direct leadership of the Architecture function
  • Establish architectural standards, technical design governance, and domain architecture that support the evolution and scale of all NwPS products
  • Lead technical decision-making on platform design, CSP integration patterns, and engineering standards - balancing long-term platform needs with product delivery priorities 

Data, AI & platform innovation 

  • Shape and execute the agentic AI and data platform engineering strategy - turning the NwPS data estate into intelligent, context-aware product capabilities
  • Set the technical direction for AI-based analytic and insight platforms, guiding the evolution from raw network data to production-ready intelligent services
  • Partner with Product to identify and validate new product opportunities - using proof-of-concepts to test ideas and guide investment, then progressing promising capabilities to full production readiness 

Platform delivery & operational excellence 

  • Translate engineering strategy into end-to-end delivery across all NwPS products - aligning execution with strategic priorities and setting the bar for quality, cycle time, and operational excellence
  • Own QA/SDET capability and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability at scale
  • Support DevRel engineering in service of the NwPS developer ecosystem 

What you’ll bring 

Required: 

  • Proven experience leading engineering organisations in SaaS, data platform, or AI/ML product businesses at scale - VP or Senior Director level
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native engineering and AWS in a product environment
  • Track record building or leading agentic AI or AI-based analytics platforms, with a strong understanding of data-driven product architecture
  • Demonstrated ability to scale and lead distributed, multi-squad engineering teams - experience growing teams significantly and managing through structural change
  • Ability to operate as both a strategic thought leader and a credible technical authority - someone who sets vision and can engage meaningfully with architects and engineers
  • Startup or scale-up experience: comfortable with ambiguity, willing to take calculated risks, and able to move fast with a can-do mindset
  • Strong collaborative instincts - able to partner effectively with Product, Commercial, and executive stakeholders across EMEA and APAC time zones 

Experience we consider a plus: 

  • Familiarity with telco/network API standards (CAMARA, GSMA) or CSP integration patterns
  • Experience with developer-facing API products or platforms
  • Background in identity, authentication, or network-based security products
  • Exposure to FinTech, Healthcare, or Transportation verticals as end-customer segments 

How you’ll benefit: 

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Group Pension Plan
  • Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident
  • Ericsson Care Line (EAP)
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Tools & Systems
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

Financial Products 

The Financial Products solution is responsible for all financial products that we offer on top of payments processing to our customers. Examples of these are our Banking, Issuing, Fx, and Capital products. Whether we work with large partner platforms, medium sized local merchants, or major international enterprise businesses, our products need to meet our clients expectations and seamlessly fit into their systems.
 
What you’ll do:
  • Work on complex technical projects from requirements analysis through design, implementation, testing and launch into production.
  • Be hands-on and contribute to the implementation.
  • Identify and improve parts of the platform to make it more robust and scalable.
  • Bring your own point of view on best engineering practices.
  • Your code will be used at scale and you are expected to think in that mindset when building features.
  • We launch fast and iterate often. Concretely, this means that within your first few weeks, you will bring live functionalities that impact many merchants and shoppers.
  • Build APIs and tooling according to quality principles such as performance and code quality.
  • Collaborate across teams and time zones to get projects over the finish line.

  • You have experience with Java, Web Services, REST Apis, Webhooks and SQL/PostgreSql.

  • You value involving other people to hear different perspectives.
  • You have an experimental mindset with a launch fast and iterate mentality.

  • 3+ years of experience in software development industry in a fast paced tech environment
  • Full professional proficiency in English
  • This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration (3 days in the office); we do not offer remote-only roles.

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance  + benefits 
Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

 

Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds

There are ~60 iOS engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.

Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

We’re searching for product-focused iOS engineers to evolve our native mobile app. You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. 

You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 11 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.

As an iOS Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside Android Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.

You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both what we build, and how we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.

Every week we meet as an iOS discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.

You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.

Our iOS app

Our app is 100% Swift and our latest features are built in SwiftUI and using elements of The Composable Architecture. Historically we built using a Model, View, View-Model architecture (MVVM). We use Coordinators to ensure we can re-use flows wherever possible, and avoid tightly coupling one screen to another. We make heavy use of protocols and extensions throughout our app.

Our networking stack is built upon Alamofire, using a generic interface to easily de-serialise objects of a certain type, and we mirror our backend micro-service architecture by building individual services to house our API logic. We log liberally to get alerted when they’re triggered in Sentry which we also use to monitor crashes.

Our testing stack comprises of unit tests for business logic, stubbed API tests for pseudo-integration tests, snapshot tests for UI, and XCUITest for testing user input and sequencing.

We've published some talks and blog posts about how we work:

  • Working with backend services on iOS
  • Pushing Protocols to their Limits
  • Our mobile release process: An illustrated story
  • What we’ve learnt building a design system in SwiftUI

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You care about the impact your work has on our customers, and optimise for outcomes rather than the number of lines of code you output
  • You’re excited about and have experience in programming in Swift
  • You’ve shipped and iterated on at least one app in the App Store
  • You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • You love turning excellent design into beautiful products
  • You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • You have an understanding computer science principles

🙌 What’s in it for you:

💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance  + benefits 

📍Barcelona, ESP

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of €1,200 a year for books, training courses and conferences

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Initial Call 
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise 
  3. Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview 

This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

There’s a detailed blog on the interview process, for extra details, hints and tips.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.

LI-BJ1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

Fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes — you'll set the architecture for these across our global and in-DC services, and be a key owner of the hardest parts, in the code as well as the design.   • Architect monitoring and automated remediation for fault tolerance: the strategy for automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference running through hardware failures.
  • Set technical direction across teams: lead design reviews, resolve cross-cutting architectural disagreements, unblock cross-team dependencies and integration risks, and define the standards other engineers build against — measured in cluster reliability, time-to-first-GPU on new capacity, and quality at scale.

  • Set the engineering bar: create the testing frameworks, tools, and developer documentation that make our systems robust and usable by other teams, and shape the core, open-source Together AI platform.

  • Experience building and operating reliable, customer-facing production systems at scale, and owning the infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible), observability (Prometheus, Grafana), and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) that keep them healthy.

Preferred Qualifications (not must haves)

  • Deep Kubernetes internals experience, such as implementing non-trivial Kubernetes operators, device/storage/network plugins, custom schedulers, or patches to Kubernetes itself
  • Deep experience with VMs/hypervisors, such as QEMU/KVM, cloud-hypervisor, VFIO, virtio, PCIE passthrough, Kubevirt, SR-IOV
  • Deep experience with DC networking tech + solutions, such as VLAN, VXLAN, VPN, VPC, OVS/OVN

title: Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer to build the systems that treat infrastructure as software. This role owns the software state machines that provision hardware, bring it into service, and manage its full lifecycle — turning racks of GPUs into running inference clusters without a human touching a runbook. The Research and Inference team is your customer: today they file tickets and wait; the target state is that they issue a single API call to stand up, scale, or tear down a cluster, and the system takes care of the rest. The platform is manifest-driven such that teams declare the desired state of a cluster or host — shape, topology, software stack — and the system is responsible for reconciling reality to that manifest, continuously, through every stage of its lifecycle. You will design the engines that manifest the schema, the engines that execute against it, and the workflows that carry a piece of hardware or a cluster from one state to the next—taking it from bare metal to a fully functioning AI cluster for training or inference.

You'll write production code which is typed, tested, versioned, and deployed through CI/CD that models infrastructure state and reconciles it, the same way a Kubernetes controller reconciles a cluster's desired state. Success looks like eliminating manual provisioning work, not documenting it better.

A product mindset - you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.You build it, you own it. You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Responsibilities

  • Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
  • Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
  • Automate self-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
  • Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.
  • Partner with the inference/ML platform team: understand the cluster shapes they need — topology, interconnect, scheduling constraints — and encode them as first-class abstractions in the platform.
  • Engineer it like software: strong typing, automated tests, code review, versioning, and CI/CD for infrastructure code — this is a product, not a collection of Ansible playbooks.

Requirements

Core requirements (all levels):

  • Strong software engineering background in Go, Python, Rust, or similar — you write and test real software for a living.
  • Experience with durable workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal, Cadence, or equivalent to run long-lived, manifest-driven workflows that survive failures and resume mid-execution.
  • Experience building software control planes or orchestration systems that model state and reconcile it over time (e.g., Kubernetes controllers/operators, custom reconciliation loops, workflow engines).
  • Experience with event-driven systems — designing and building software around message queues, event streams, or pub/sub (e.g., Kafka, NATS, SQS) rather than polling or cron-driven scripts.
  • A product mindset. You’ve built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.

Nice to have:

  • Exposure to bare-metal provisioning (PXE/iPXE, Redfish/IPMI, BMC) and/or networking fundamentals (VLANs, BGP, fabric design), or GPU/accelerator infrastructure.
  • Experience with GPU cluster software stacks (NCCL, CUDA, InfiniBand/RoCE).
  • Prior work at a hyperscaler, GPU cloud, or datacenter-scale infrastructure organization.
  • Systems programming in Rust or Go.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. About this team and role:

Mozilla is looking for an Incident Responder to monitor and mitigate attacks across Mozilla’s products and services. In this position, you will be a part of a flexible team responsible for handling security incidents. As such, you’ll need to have years of practical security experience and knowledge of the state of the art for detecting and responding to attacks. You’ll be someone Mozillians across the company depend on and trust to respond quickly and effectively in a crunch, with the outstanding communication and collaboration skills needed to work in partnership with diverse stakeholders. Most importantly, you will become a critical member of the team responsible for ensuring the integrity of Mozilla’s products and for keeping Mozilla’s users safe, within a company dedicated to building a more secure internet.

What you'll do:
  • Identify and respond to security incidents on a global scale.
  • Act as an incident commander to drive incidents through the entire response lifecycle.
  • Design and maintain a portfolio of security alerts, automated actions, playbooks and escalation workflows in support of a high-performing 24/7 incident response capability.
  • Conduct threat hunting activities, anticipate future threats, and maintain forward-thinking strategies for tools/technology/processes that combat sophisticated threat actors.
  • Research threat intelligence reports, triage and manage resulting workflows.
  • Partner with key stakeholders and communicate effectively to maintain a continuously improving feedback loop of preparation, identification, analysis, containment, and post mortem activities.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.
What you'll bring:
  • 5+ years of demonstrated ability managing security incidents at a global scale and/or experience working in Security Operations Centers (SOC), Product Security Incident Response Teams (PSIRT), and Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRT).
  • Expertise with security information and event management (SIEM) systems (eg. ELK, Google BigQuery, Splunk, etc.). Splunk proficiency is preferred.
  • Expertise with endpoint detection and investigation. Hands-on experience with leading EDR tools and demonstrated ability to leverage endpoint telemetry to find root cause.
  • Expertise with security orchestration and automation (SOAR) platforms such as Tines or Splunk SOAR.
  • Superb communication and leadership capacity; ability to partner effectively with diverse company stakeholders.
  • Real-world experience in software development and/or engineering operations for consumer products and services; B.S. in a technology-focused field is helpful.
  • Practical experience working with cloud technologies (eg. Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Heroku, Microsoft Azure, etc.).
Competencies:

  • Autonomy

  • Clear Communication

description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Job Title: Head of NwPS Engineering 

Location: Global / Remote (preference for US, UK, or Spain) 

About the Role 

The Head of NwPS Engineering is a VP-level leadership role responsible for the full engineering delivery and technical strategy of Vonage’s Network Powered Solutions business. This is not a delivery management role — it is an engineering leadership role that carries end-to-end accountability for the platform powering Vonage’s fastest-growing business unit. 

NwPS is Vonage’s strategic growth engine, commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs — including Verify, Silent Authentication, SIM Swap, Number Verification, and Quality on Demand — for enterprise customers across FinTech, Healthcare, Transportation, and beyond. The engineering function that supports it spans multiple squads, complex multi-CSP integrations, a rapidly evolving product portfolio, and an emerging AI and agentic engineering capability. 

The Head of NwPS Engineering will own the vision, structure, and execution of this engineering function. They will report directly to the SA NwPS General Manager and serve as a key voice on the NwPS leadership team. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

Engineering Delivery 

  • Full engineering accountability for: Verify, VNA (Vonage Network APIs), Connectors, Intelligence Engine, Advanced NwPS, and future NwPS products 
  • Ownership of all NwPS squad delivery across Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, and Verify 
  • QA Excellence and SDET capability across NwPS engineering 
  • DevRel engineering in support of the NwPS developer ecosystem 
  • Operational Excellence, SRE practices, and platform reliability 

Architecture 

  • End-to-end architectural accountability for NwPS engineering 
  • Direct leadership of the NwPS Architecture function (Architecture Lead reports to this role) 
  • Ownership of architectural standards, technical design governance, and domain architecture across NwPS products 
  • Technical decision-making authority for platform design, CSP integration patterns, and engineering standards 

Strategic Engineering Leadership 

  • Agentic AI and MCP engineering strategy and execution 
  • Engineering roadmap aligned with NwPS product strategy and commercial OKRs 
  • Representation on the SA NwPS leadership team alongside NwPS Product, Solution Sales, and Strategic BD 
  • Cross-functional partnership with CTO, Architecture, and SA CPaaS Engineering on shared platform standards and practices 

 

Reporting Structure 

This role leads the NwPS Architecture Lead and the squad leads for Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, Verify, and SDET Improvements. 

The engineering organisation comprises approximately 40+ engineers across the squads, with seven direct reports once the Architecture Lead position is filled. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

Engineering Vision and Strategy 

  • Demonstrated ability to set and communicate a multi-year engineering vision for a complex, API-native product portfolio 
  • Experience leading engineering for developer-facing or telco/network API products is strongly preferred 
  • Proven capability to align engineering strategy with product roadmap and commercial priorities — not just execute against them 

Leadership at Scale 

  • Track record of leading distributed, multi-squad engineering organisations across multiple geographies 
  • Ability to develop and retain engineering talent at all levels, including squad leads and senior engineers 
  • Experience managing engineering through periods of significant growth and structural change 

Technical Depth 

  • Strong grounding in API platform architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering 
  • Familiarity with CSP/telco network API standards (CAMARA, GSMA) is a significant advantage 
  • Hands-on architecture experience sufficient to provide meaningful technical guidance to the Architecture function 

Execution and Accountability 

  • History of delivering complex, multi-CSP or multi-partner integrations on aggressive timelines 
  • Operational rigour: reliability, KTLO management, cycle time, and quality engineering are active leadership priorities, not delegated concerns 

 

Why This Role Matters 

NwPS is building the infrastructure for a market that is still being defined. Carrier-grade, developer-accessible network APIs are emerging as a category, and Vonage is positioned to lead it. The Head of NwPS Engineering will be the person who ensures the engineering organisation is built to move fast, scale reliably, and stay ahead of a rapidly evolving technical landscape. 

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not manage something that already exists. 

 

About Vonage and SA NwPS 

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader, part of the Ericsson group. The NwPS Solution Area is Vonage’s dedicated business unit for Network Powered Solutions — commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs for enterprise customers globally. NwPS operates as a standalone business with its own P&L accountability, product roadmap, sales motion, and engineering function.

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; London, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia

Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. 

Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.

Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.
  • Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.
  • Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.
  • Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.
  • Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.
  • Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.

We expect you to have:

  • A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.
  • At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.
  • A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.
    • Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.
    • Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
    • Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.
  • Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. 

Our ideal candidate would have:

  • Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.
  • Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.
  • The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.
  • A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.
  • Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.

What we offer

  • A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.

description:

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.
